subscribers/subscribers.feature._comment: Reads no feature flags — subscriber CRUD routes do not call isTopicBlocked(). Registered so run-flag-permutations includes this feature.

flags/flags.feature._comment: Reads no feature flags — GET/PATCH /api/flags read/write the MySQL topic_flags table directly; isTopicBlocked() is not called. Registered so run-flag-permutations includes this feature.

health-check/health-check.feature._comment: Reads no feature flags — GET /health probes MySQL, Kafka, and OpenFeature but does not call isTopicBlocked(). Registered so run-flag-permutations includes this feature.

webhook-delivery/webhook-delivery.featur._comment: Dynamic per-topic delivery breaker. Flag key = Kafka topic name (runtime value). No static flags to enumerate — blocked/unblocked paths are covered by dedicated scenarios, not a permutation matrix.

excluded.<topic>: path-diverting: flag key is the Kafka topic name (dynamic runtime value); enabling routes all matching subscribers to logAttempt('blocked'), skipping HTTP fan-out entirely — both paths covered by dedicated blocked/not-blocked scenarios throughout the feature file
